scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env prod
scripts.ts:workers: npx nitro prepare --dir workers/sender && npx vue-tsc --noEmit -p workers/sender/tsconfig.json
scripts.pre:all: npm run lint && npm run pre:c4 && npm run ts && npm run ts:server && npm run ts:node && npm run ts:workers
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:ui && npm run test:e2e:ui:serial
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run test:bdd:generate && BDD_SUITE=smoke PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=test-results/e2e-smoke-results.json npx playwright test --project=chromium-smoke
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:ui
scripts.db:seed:local: npx wrangler d1 execute theslope --file migrations/seed/seed.sql --local
scripts.db:seed:dev: npx wrangler d1 execute theslope --file migrations/seed/seed.sql --env=dev --remote
scripts.db:seed:prod: npx wrangler d1 execute theslope-prod --file migrations/seed/seed.sql --env=prod --remote
scripts.db:seed:service-accounts:local: npx wrangler d1 execute theslope --file migrations/seed/service-accounts.sql --local
scripts.db:seed:service-accounts:dev: npx wrangler d1 execute theslope --file migrations/seed/service-accounts.sql --env=dev --remote
scripts.db:seed:service-accounts:prod: npx wrangler d1 execute theslope-prod --file migrations/seed/service-accounts.sql --env=prod --remote
scripts.db:seed:all:local: npm run db:seed:local && npm run db:seed:service-accounts:local
scripts.db:seed:all:dev: npm run db:seed:dev && npm run db:seed:service-accounts:dev
scripts.db:seed:all:prod: npm run db:seed:prod && npm run db:seed:service-accounts:prod
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply theslope --local
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply theslope --remote --env=dev
scripts.db:migrate:prod: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply theslope-prod --env=prod --remote
